# Image export

::: warning Preview version
The jsMind V2 programming API is currently a preview. The API will change in later updates. Please check this documentation anytime for the interface that is current.
:::

Types used by `JsMind.exportImage`.

This page is generated from the published typings `dist/jsmind.d.ts` with TypeDoc.

## JmExportImageOptions {#JmExportImageOptions}

*Interface*

Options for exporting the rendered mind map to an image.

**Properties**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quality` (optional) | number | Quality for the lossy formats, 0 to 1. Ignored for PNG, where the browser rejects a quality argument. |
| `scale` (optional) | number | Device pixel ratio to render at. 2 gives a crisp result on high-density screens and stays cheap; 1 mirrors what the user sees. |
| `transparent` (optional) | boolean | Leave the canvas background transparent instead of filling it with the theme color. Opt-in; the default export is unchanged. JPEG has no alpha channel, so this option is ignored with a warning when `type` is `image/jpeg`. Since: 2.1.0 |
| `type` (optional) | [JmImageType](/en/reference/api/export#JmImageType) | Output format. JPEG and WebP are lossy, PNG is not. |

## JmExportImageResult {#JmExportImageResult}

*Interface*

The encoded image returned by [JsMind.exportImage](/en/reference/api/jsmind#JsMind.exportImage), plus its dimensions.

**Properties**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blob` | `Blob` |  |
| `cssHeight` | number | Content height in CSS pixels, before scaling. |
| `cssWidth` | number | Content width in CSS pixels, before scaling. |
| `height` | number | Pixel height of the image. |
| `width` | number | Pixel width of the image, i.e. the content width times `scale`. |
